column1: Freddie Freeman stands out as the top pick with a strong track record of consistency and a favorable platoon advantage against Merrill Kelly. Elly De La Cruz also offers reliability at the top of the order, backed by a solid hit probability and a park boost. Shohei Ohtani and Jeremy Pena remain steady options, both benefiting from advantageous matchups. All four are well-positioned for Beat The Streak lineups, but Freeman’s steady production gives him the edge.
